caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded, bulbous body tapering upward to a narrow neck and small opening. The jug is colored in various shades of brown with subtle gradients and highlights suggesting the contours and reflections on its surface. There are some darker areas indicating shadows and lighter spots simulating areas where light hits the surface. The jug has one handle, which is attached from the top of the neck to the upper shoulder of the body, and the handle is also shaded to produce a three-dimensional effect. The background is a uniform, light beige color with no additional objects or designs. There is minimal text: a mirrored inscription on the left, and a rectangular label on the lower right with the printed word "[J.W. JORDAN]."
title: Demi-John Pottery
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
